description: This file defines a controller class for managing Return Reasons in the Opencart admin localisation module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting return reasons with support for pagination, sorting, and language-specific descriptions.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class for handling return reasons, extending the base Controller class, providing CRUD operations and listing functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of return reasons with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a list of return reasons with applied sorting and pagination, returning HTML view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Processes request parameters and retrieves the list of return reasons from the model, returning a view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of return reasons with sorting and pagination applied.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return reason, pre-filled if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated return reason data, with permission checks, responds with JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return reasons after permission validation, returns JSON status.
